Requirements You are in Storm Surge Stance.

Your weapon creates a wave of your aspect’s element with a wide swing. You swing your weapon outward as if to make a Strike, channeling your aspect in a 20-foot cone. Creatures in the area are assailed by a magical wave of your storm aspect and must make a Reflex saving throw.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the damage of a roll of your weapon’s damage dice as your aspect damage.

Failure As success, but it deals full damage instead of half.

Critical Failure As success, but it deals double damage instead of half.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.8ad23sFdfBpqwklz]{Aspect of Skies}, your wave forms as a storm cloud in the area. The area crackles with lightning for 1 round, and any creature who ends their turn in the area or enters it must make the saving throw against your aspected damage again. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.pid3Nv3o23ilx3n6]{Aspect of Tides}, creatures who fail are trapped in a watery bubble and suffer a -10 foot status penalty to their speeds on a failure or become Immobilized on a critical failure for 1 round.
